args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight tickets, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and extra batteries/memory cards
- Travel insurance information
- Medications and prescriptions
- Reusable water bottle

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Light, breathable clothing (t-shirts, shorts, sundresses)
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses
- Sleepwear
- Undergarments
- One nice outfit for dinner/luau

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel - optional as rentals available)
- Beach bag
- Water shoes (for rocky beaches)

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Hiking gear for Diamond Head (sturdy shoes, water, hat)
- Comfortable clothes for Pearl Harbor visit
- Swimwear and towel for Kailua Beach kayaking
- Casual outfits for shopping at Ala Moana Center

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (optional)
- Insect repellent

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Small backpack or day bag
- Books or e-reader for relaxation days
- Travel pillow for flights
- Snacks for day trips
- Small first aid kit
- Hand sanitizer
- Ziplock bags for wet items

REMEMBER:
- Check luggage weight restrictions before packing
- Leave some space in luggage for souvenirs
- Consider laundry options if staying for extended periods
